This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.298/2020 registered at Police Station - Civil Lines, District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 506, 34 of IPC and Section 66(D) of I.T. Act.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 22.07.2025.

Charge sheet has been filed.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the objector as well as State have opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and have submitted that present applicant and co-accused forcibly committed rape with the prosecutrix.
Named F.I.R. has been lodged against the applicant and co- accused.
The prosecutrix in the Court statement has also deposed against the applicant.
It is further submitted that during the course of incident, video was also made by co-accused.

It is also submitted that when prosecutrix has deposed against present applicant in the Court statement, therefore if any affidavit is obtained by the present applicant from the victim, then it has no value in the eyes of law.
